listingStrategy.problem: Lisa's own listings don't rank when someone Googles the property address. 360 address-like queries in Search Console show her site gets impressions (Google knows about the pages) but ranks at position 10-40 with near-zero clicks. Zillow, Redfin, and Realtor.com consistently outrank her.
whyThisHappens: Portal sites (Zillow, Redfin, Realtor.com) have massive domain authority (DA 90+) vs. p3realtync.com
Portal listing pages have rich structured data (RealEstateListing schema) — Lisa's pages have none (and existing JSON-LD has parse errors)
Portal pages have thousands of internal links from city/state/county hub pages — Lisa's listing pages are orphaned (0 internal links)
Portal pages aggregate user reviews, saved counts, and price history — Lisa's pages have IDX data only with no unique content
Portal pages are optimized for address queries with exact-match titles and meta descriptions — Lisa's have generic Sierra Interactive defaults

immediate.action: Add RealEstateListing schema to every active listing page
immediate.detail: Include @type, name (full address), description, price, numberOfBedrooms, numberOfBathroomsTotal, floorSize, photo, address, geo coordinates, and Lisa as the agent
immediate.impact: Enables rich results with property details directly in search — levels the playing field with portals

immediate.action: Rewrite listing page titles to: '[Address] | [City] NC Home for Sale | Lisa Johnson'
immediate.detail: Current titles are generic — address in title is the strongest on-page signal for address queries
immediate.impact: Direct ranking factor for address searches

immediate.action: Write unique meta descriptions per listing with address, price, and key features
immediate.detail: Current descriptions are platform defaults — unique descriptions improve CTR even if ranking doesn't change immediately

shortTerm.action: Add 200-400 words of unique agent commentary to each listing page
shortTerm.detail: Include: why Lisa chose to list this home, neighborhood highlights, nearby amenities, school district info, what makes this property special — content Zillow can't replicate
shortTerm.impact: Unique content differentiates from portals — Google rewards original content over syndicated IDX data

shortTerm.action: Link each listing page from its county/area page and related blog posts
shortTerm.detail: Currently 0 internal links to listing pages — add contextual links from Johnston County page, 'no HOA homes' page, etc.
shortTerm.impact: Fixes orphan status and passes link equity to listing pages

shortTerm.detail: Schools within 5 miles, average commute, nearby shopping/dining, HOA details if applicable — structured content that Zillow doesn't provide per-listing
shortTerm.impact: Increases page depth and dwell time — signals quality to Google
